title: Job: Wisdom Is with God

questions.question: What sarcastic remark does Job make to his friends?
options: No doubt you are the people, and wisdom will die with you
questions.correctAnswer: No doubt you are the people, and wisdom will die with you
questions.explanation: Job 12:2 (ESV): "No doubt you are the people, and wisdom will die with you."

questions.question: Who is a laughingstock to his friends?
questions.explanation: Job 12:4 (ESV): "I am a laughingstock to my friends... the just and blameless man is a laughingstock."

questions.question: Who dwells securely?
questions.explanation: Job 12:6 (ESV): "The tents of robbers are at peace, and those who provoke God are secure..."

questions.question: Who does Job say to ask for teaching?
questions.explanation: Job 12:7 (ESV): "But ask the beasts, and they will teach you; the birds of the heavens, and they will tell you;"

questions.question: In whose hand is the life of every living thing?
questions.explanation: Job 12:10 (ESV): "In his hand is the life of every living thing and the breath of all mankind."

questions.question: Does not the ear test words as the palate tastes what?
questions.explanation: Job 12:11 (ESV): "Does not the ear test words as the palate tastes food?"

questions.question: With whom is wisdom?
questions.explanation: Job 12:12 (ESV): "Wisdom is with the aged, and understanding in length of days."

questions.question: What happens if God tears down?
questions.explanation: Job 12:14 (ESV): "If he tears down, none can rebuild; if he shuts a man in, none can open."

questions.question: He leads counselors away stripped, and makes fools of whom?
questions.explanation: Job 12:17 (ESV): "He leads counselors away stripped, and makes fools of judges."

questions.question: He uncovers the deeps out of darkness and brings what to light?
questions.explanation: Job 12:22 (ESV): "He uncovers the deeps out of darkness and brings deep darkness to light."

questions.question: He looses the bonds of kings and binds a waistcloth on their what?
questions.explanation: Job 12:18 (ESV): "He looses the bonds of kings and binds a waistcloth on their hips."

questions.question: He deprives of speech those who are what?
questions.explanation: Job 12:20 (ESV): "He deprives of speech those who are trusted and takes away the discernment of the elders."

questions.question: He pours contempt on whom?
questions.explanation: Job 12:21 (ESV): "He pours contempt on princes and loosens the belt of the strong."

questions.question: He makes them stagger like a what?
questions.explanation: Job 12:25 (ESV): "They grope in the dark without light, and he makes them stagger like a drunken man."

questions.question: Who are the "people" in Job's sarcastic remark?
questions.explanation: Job 12:2 (ESV): "No doubt you are the people..." referring to his friends.

key_verse_text: With God are wisdom and might; he has counsel and understanding.
